intent: Resolve all findings from the monitoring and alerting review without changing the public monitoring contracts.
appliedFixes: Expose series activity and freshness, filter empty historical series, and suppress stale overview values.
Invalidate cached read-only metric connections after catalog failures and return path-free service errors.
Retire inactive metric series and enforce per-metric and global quotas without double eviction.
Remove the obsolete TypeScript metrics writer, collectors, scheduler, and database dependency.
Preserve consecutive recovering semantics and delay alerter readiness until a successful evaluation pass.
Reject unavailable SMTP tests safely and clean up completed test deliveries.
Coalesce health alert flaps, retain the latest health alert identity, and aggregate health incidents efficiently.
Add incident detail, timeline, delivery, snapshot, and silence workflows with race-safe refresh and focus restoration.
Prevent duplicated date/time rendering in monitoring, settings, and notification views.
Extend CM5 deployment verification with dashboard query, alerter freshness, latency, size, and point-count gates.
Restrict Nginx JSON compression so server-sent event streams remain unbuffered.
advisoryOutputs: A real CM5 24-hour soak remains a release verification activity and was not executed in this local review.
